fix: skip the deny when every path argument resolves outside the indexed repo, and probe the server endpoint the session uses (or the session's MCP status) instead of ps
how: zuvo-plugin session 2026-10-15/18: MCP reported 'codesift (ECONNREFUSED)' and its tools were removed, yet `grep -rl … ~/.claude/hooks` and `find ~/.zuvo/bench …` were denied 'Current repo is indexed by CodeSift'. isCodesiftServerRunning (shared.ts:62) checks for ANY server process via ps, not this session's connection; the path arguments are never compared with the indexed repo root
title: precheck-bash denies grep/find even when the session's CodeSift MCP is disconnected and when the paths are outside the indexed repo, leaving the agent with no search tool
